algorithm: Reviewed authored readings retain future cache precedence; this component is QA-only.
Protect code/URLs/Latin identifiers and exact numeric/name bytes. Email punctuation remains between protected Latin chunks without introduced separators. No global email-validation regex.
Apply locale-ja CF LatinTranscription only to contiguous Japanese-script runs; retain exact source UTF16 partitions, raw native tokens and any gaps.
Accept native Latin letters/combining marks/apostrophes/hyphens, including spelling-based particles and ordinary long-vowel conventions. No generic toLatin.

Only an exact terminal raw~tsu backed by sourceっ/ッ/ｯ may compose across immediately adjacent converted tokens with a valid consonant onset. ch maps doubled onset t; bdfghjkpstvwz map their initial. Unknown/final/unsupported marker abstains. Raw token evidence retained separately from merged display pieces.
Unknown unprotected scripts, missing/nonLatin native readings, invalid ranges, or >16384UTF16 produce no full reading, never silently dropped source.
Original script/audio/copy unaffected; no sentence overrides, added models, phonetic-perfection or population claims.
retained_limits: ha/he/wo particles,watakushi/asu variants and morpheme-separated words are retained as convention limits, not verified pronunciation.
Adjacent nonspaced URL text is inherently ambiguous; whole opaque URL bytes stay untouched.
System dictionaries can choose contextual readings incorrectly; this capture cannot establish comprehensive semantic accuracy.
